remarks: Welcome to this charming 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath rental located in Stamford's prestigious Shippan neighborhood. This home, part of a two-family property, offers bright and spacious living areas, a private deck perfect for outdoor relaxation, and two dedicated parking spots for added convenience. Shippan is renowned for its coastal charm, featuring quiet, tree-lined streets and proximity to Long Island Sound. Enjoy nearby waterfront parks like Cummings Park and West Beach, offering sandy shores, picnic areas, and breathtaking views. The location provides the best of both worlds-just minutes from Stamford's vibrant downtown with its array of restaurants, shopping, and entertainment, as well as quick access to Stamford's Metro-North station and I-95 for seamless commuting. Experience the unique lifestyle of Shippan in this inviting and well-located rental.
